ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white) coverage concentrated in the distal regions of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, asymmetrical, high-intensity white blobs located on the outer distal portions of the left and right lobes; these regions show internal mottling and irregular boundaries, while the central region and leading edges maintain solid low-intensity dark pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, central V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 75 degrees and a high-ratio depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated profile featuring multiple distinct peaks and deep valleys; prominent indentations are localized on the upper-left lobe trailing edge, with finer-frequency serrations across the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex outer margins sweeping outward and upward from the peduncle, exhibiting a sharp recurve towards the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A vertical cluster of approximately 5-7 small, circular, high-contrast white dots localized on the extreme lateral edge of the left fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple near-vertical linear disruptions; a prominent dark linear mark is visible on the right lobe surface running from the mid-section toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notches and tissue loss along the upper trailing edge of the left lobe; presence of vertical rake marks across the central-right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'wing-tip' pigmentation pattern where white coverage is almost exclusively limited to the distal outer corners of the lobes.
